item.title: Introducing KeySense (PySpark) – Finding Your Dataset's True Grain
item.description:
Why KeySense?

In the world of data engineering, one of the most overlooked problems is determining a dataset’s grain — the unique combination of columns that defines each record.
Most data quality frameworks assume you already know this grain, but in reality, it’s rarely documented, often misunderstood, and prone to grain drift over time.

Grain drift happens when the real-world uniqueness of your data changes silently — duplicates creep in, KPIs break, joins explode, and trust in the data erodes.

item.title: Why Performance Optimization Deserves Your Focus
item.description:
🧭 My Journey Through the Evolution of Data Engineering

Over the last 12 years, I’ve worked across Oracle, Informatica, Redshift, Spark, and modern big data stacks. My teams have owned and operated mission-critical data pipelines — pipelines that often held the fate of dashboards, reports, and leadership decisions.

There were countless nights when things went wrong — a fix was made, and we had no option but to wait several hours to validate if it actually worked. Sample runs weren’t enough. Real validation needed full data processing. And until the pipelines completed, no one had answers.
